payload.acceptance_criteria:
Every outcome of install, init, link and migrate prints its result on the first line and "next: COMMAND" on the last; a refusal prints "refused: REASON" and "fix: EXACT COMMAND".
In a git repository, init installs the skills and creates a local vault in the user state folder, named by its genesis commit, and the committed .basicly-tracker.toml holds no absolute path.
When init finds an existing ledger, issues.jsonl, br or beans source, it creates the vault, does not attach, and names migrate as the next command; outside a git repository it installs the skills and names the repository step.
A vault moved before this change, whose toml names its URL, still resolves to its existing clone.

payload.acceptance_criteria:
migrate removes the git user.name, user.email, the "Full Name <email>" form, the login name, host names and home paths by default, --redact-name takes several values, and it refuses to publish unless a personal-data scan finds zero.
migrate validates the source schema and size before any write, previews by default, publishes only with --yes, and keeps no private map unless --private-map FILE is given.
migrate deletes the derived caches before the freeze, commits the freeze, and attaches only after counts and digests match.
A second migrate after success prints "already migrated" and exits 0; several sources are listed and refused with the next command.

payload.acceptance_criteria:
link previews the masked target, projects, counts, visibility and personal-data counts, and publishes only with --yes.
link pushes to an empty remote, joins a remote that holds the same vault, and refuses a remote with foreign commits naming the fix.
link refuses a vault more public than the most private attached code repository, or requires --visibility when the host cannot tell.
link accepts a username-only HTTPS address, refuses passwords, never writes userinfo to the toml, runs ssh in batch mode, and prints the credential fix for GitHub, Bitbucket and ssh.
